description: Giribawa Pradeshiya Sabha - Pradeshiya Sabha Giribawa. Imposing Entertainment Tax. Governor - North Western Province.
categorisation: This gazette notification imposes an entertainment tax under specific ordinances and acts (Entertainment Tax Ordinance No. 12 of 1946, Provincial Council Act No. 12 of 1989, Pradeshiya Sabha Act No. 15 of 1987). It deals with regulatory matters and tax implementation, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification. While it mentions the Governor's name, this is in the context of approving a regulatory decision, not a personnel appointment or government restructuring with portfolio details.
